sections.title: Risk Factors
sections.excerpt: RISK FACTORS In addition to the other information contained in or incorporated by reference into this proxy statement/ ​ prospectus, including the matters addressed under the caption entitled “Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements,” First Illinois shareholders should carefully consider the following factors in deciding whether to approve the merger proposal or otherwise evaluate the merger. Please see the section entitled “Where You Can Find More Information.” Risks Related to the Merger The exchange ratio is fixed for the stock consideration and will not be adjusted in the event of any change in FFC’s stock price. Because the market price of FFC common stock will fluctuate, holders of First Illinois common stock who receive stock consideration cannot be certain of the market value of the merger consideration they will receive.
